text:
if I dare

to look and to speak

it is because of his shadow

joined so softly

to my name

far away

in the rain

in my memory

because of his face

which, burning in my poem,

beautifully scatters

a perfume

O beloved vanished face

translation.title: Meaning of His Absence
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the syntax of dependence: speech becomes possible only through the absent face.
